mapper.sql: id, statement_id, cash_account_id, line_no, bank_transaction_ref, value_date, direction, amount, counterparty_name, reference_text, matched_amount, match_status, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_bank_statement_line WHERE statement_id = #{statementId} ORDER BY line_no

SELECT FROM t_bank_statement_line WHERE cash_account_id = #{cashAccountId} AND match_status IN ('UNMATCHED', 'PARTIALLY_MATCHED') AND direction = #{direction} AND statement_id IN (SELECT s.id FROM t_bank_statement s WHERE s.cash_account_id = #{cashAccountId} AND s.status = 'IMPORTED') ORDER BY value_date, id

SELECT direction, COUNT(*) AS line_count, SUM(amount - matched_amount) AS unmatched_amount FROM t_bank_statement_line WHERE match_status IN ('UNMATCHED', 'PARTIALLY_MATCHED', 'EXCEPTION') AND statement_id IN (SELECT s.id FROM t_bank_statement s WHERE s.status = 'IMPORTED' AND s.currency = #{currency})
AND cash_account_id IN (SELECT a.id FROM t_cash_account a WHERE a.entity_type = 'OPERATING_ENTITY' AND a.entity_id = #{entityNo})
GROUP BY direction ORDER BY direction
